> Awe\-inspiring science reporting, technology news, and DIY projects\. Skunks to space robots, primates to climates\. That's Popular Science, for over 150 years strong\.

Generated by Yoast SEO v27.6, this is an llms.txt file, meant for consumption by LLMs.

## Pages
- [About Us \| Popular Science](https://www.popsci.com/about-us/): PopSci is the place to go for how\-tos, DIY projects, and science and tech news\. Stay on top of digital trends and top news stories with Popular Science\.
- [Contact Us](https://www.popsci.com/contact/): Here's how to contact Popular Science\. Email editors, inquire about advertising, and follow up about your subscription\.
- [Popular Science Editorial Standards](https://www.popsci.com/editorial-standards/)
- [How we test and review products](https://www.popsci.com/product-testing-and-review-guidelines/): We strive to treat every product and category with the same rigor that makes PopSci stories worth reading in the first place\.

## Posts
- [Children made some of the Middle East's oldest known clay figures](https://www.popsci.com/science/oldest-clay-figures-middle-east/)
- [Chunky mama bear wins 2026 Nope award for quick retreat from bigger rival](https://www.popsci.com/environment/bear-nope-award-alaska/)
- [Underwater internet cables can help save endangered whales](https://www.popsci.com/environment/underwater-internet-cables-monitor-whales/)
- [9\-foot\-tall Game Boy Color plays all the classics](https://www.popsci.com/technology/giant-game-boy-color/)
- [‘One\-in\-a\-million’ yellow fish found in New York](https://www.popsci.com/environment/rare-yellow-fish-found-new-york/)
